exposure: Transvaginal strain cervical elastography (colour codes, strain ratios)
cohort: 75 low-risk asymptomatic pregnant women undergoing transvaginal ultrasound and strain elastography in their second and third trimesters.
finding: The red colour (soft colour) at the anterior lip of the internal os was the best predictor of preterm delivery, with additional predictors being an elastography strain ratio >2 at the internal os and cervical length 2.8 cm.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy.
